posts.title: 📚 A Closed and Common Orbit
posts.description: The second book in the Wayfarers series by Becky Chambers picks up where the first one left off, but not quite. It follows side characters from the first book and two storylines whose connection doesn’t become obvious until the third act. I almost didn’t finish this one, I started it shortly after finishing the first book in August last year, but life happened and other books caught my attention.

posts.title: 🎬 The History of Concrete
posts.description: I still have yet to watch the trailer for this. I saw a few mentions of it in the feeds last Thursday, and five minutes later I had three tickets at Alamo Drafthouse.
